actions.text: Rules Committee Resolution H. Res. 988 Reported to House. Rule provides for consideration of H.R. 2988, H.R. 2262, H.R. 2270, H.R. 2312 and H.R. 4366. The resolution provides for consideration of H.R. 2988 under a structured rule, and H.R. 2262, H.R. 2270, H.R. 2312, and H.R. 4366 under a closed rule. The rule provides for one hour of general debate and one motion to recommit on each bill.

summary: The Save Local Business Act clarifies how two or more entities can be considered joint employers under the National Labor Relations Act and the Fair Labor Standards Act of 1938. Under this bill, an employer is only a joint employer of another employer's workers if it directly, actually, and immediately exercises significant control over essential employment terms and conditions.

affected_groups.effect: Must meet stricter, direct control criteria to be held legally accountable as a joint employer under federal labor standards.
Their employment relationship status with secondary or partner businesses is defined more narrowly according to direct, actual, and immediate supervisory control.

key_provisions: Amends the National Labor Relations Act to specify that a joint employer must directly, actually, and immediately exercise significant control over essential employment terms.
Provides examples of qualifying control, including hiring and discharging employees, setting pay and benefits, supervising day-to-day work, assigning schedules or tasks, and administering discipline.
Amends the Fair Labor Standards Act of 1938 to apply the same joint-employer criteria used under the National Labor Relations Act.

summary_detail.plain_summary: The Save Local Business Act clarifies how two or more entities can be considered joint employers under the National Labor Relations Act and the Fair Labor Standards Act of 1938. Under this bill, an employer is only a joint employer of another employer's workers if it directly, actually, and immediately exercises significant control over essential employment terms and conditions.
summary_detail.significance: The bill alters federal labor and wage standards by establishing a uniform and direct control test for joint employment under two major federal laws.
